entities.name: 1-Aminocyclobutan-1-ylmethanol
observations: Decoded substrate: NC1(CO)CCC1, a primary amino alcohol containing a cyclobutane ring.
The primary amine is the functional group expected to undergo reductive amination.

entities.name: Benzaldehyde
observations: Its aldehyde carbon is expected to become a benzyl group after reductive amination.

entities.name: Sodium triacetoxyborohydride
observations: Reducing agent represented by triacetoxyborohydride with sodium counterion.
Supports reduction of the imine or iminium intermediate formed from the primary amine and benzaldehyde.

entities.name: Reductive amination of amino alcohol with benzaldehyde
observations: The primary amine condenses with benzaldehyde and the resulting imine or iminium is reduced to a secondary amine.
Triethylamine and sodium bicarbonate act as bases; 1,2-dichloroethane is solvent; chloride and borohydride-derived acetate species are spectators or workup species.

entities.name: N-Benzyl-1-aminocyclobutan-1-ylmethanol
observations: A concise SMILES representation is OCC1(NCc2ccccc2)CCC1.
The alcohol remains intact while the primary amino group becomes an N-benzyl secondary amine; the free base is the most direct product assignment.
